_note: en is the source. Every other language is machine-translated and needs native-speaker review before wide promotion (see docs/sms-whatsapp.md). Words that are phase or error names come from locales/app-strings.json instead (the Android app strings). STOP, START, HELP, STATUS and LANG stay in English because carriers and the bot parse them.
